name: my-profile
_about: YOUR profile. `capcutctl profile init` copied this to your user dir (~/.config/capcutctl/profile.json).
It merges over the shipped presets/profile.json: keep only what you change and delete the rest.
Objects merge key by key; arrays and plain values replace. Set a style to null to drop a shipped one.
`capcutctl profile` prints the merged result; `capcutctl profile where` shows which files it came from.
Colours are ROLES, not hues: `brand` fills the block behind white text, `accent` marks the one key word.

brand.name: Your name or channel
brand.signature: The one thing every video of yours has, e.g. 'the last line is always the verdict, set big'.
rules: The overarching rules every video keeps, whatever its style. Four to eight lines.
One accent per piece, on at most one element per shot.
avoid: Looks you have rejected and never want proposed again, with the reason.

styles._about: Your video types. Each keeps the brand and flexes pace and emphasis. `edit.json` picks one with "style".

explainer.use: An opinion, a lesson, an argument: the face carries it.
explainer.feel: Typographic and calm. Big words, lots of empty frame, one visual idea.
explainer.accent: the one word the argument turns on
explainer.camera: slow pushes on the claims; no punches
explainer.sound: sparse: a cue on each graphic, nothing in between
